This dedicated '''[[Slicer droid/Legends|hacker droid]]''' was stationed aboard the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. During the ''Bright Hope''{{'s}} escape from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the battle, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] helped [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] [[Communications officer/Legends|Chief Controller]] [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] erase the transport's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records to prevent them from falling into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] hands.
